payload.blocks: Phase 4 (mail through the request socket) and, after it, phases 5 to 7. Phases 2 and 3 keep running.
payload.headline: Add apps/fgos/src/routing.rs to plan 261125-2313's footprint so a confined head's mailbox inbox goes through the socket?

parts.cause: The host-failed cause (forwarder.rs:509) is inside the footprint. The inbox cause is apps/fgos/src/routing.rs:660: the head window forwards only `mailbox send`, so inbox runs inside the cage. That file is outside this plan's footprint and is also listed by the running plan 261125-1631-agent-context-engine (its phase 3, still draft).

options.cost: One planner/supervisor footprint edit; no extra phase.
options.does: Add apps/fgos/src/routing.rs to this plan's footprint; phase 4 makes the one-line change ('send' | 'inbox') plus its test.
options.gain: Acceptance criterion 3 (read through the socket, no lock opened in the cage) is met with the existing router; no second socket client.
options.harm: Two plans list routing.rs. The edit is one match arm, so context-engine phase 3 rebases over it trivially.
options.label: Widen footprint by routing.rs

options.cost: Criterion 3 and phase 4 brief need rewriting.
options.does: Leave routing as is; make plain inbox read the snapshot without the write lock (inside the footprint).
options.harm: inbox --claim still fails in the cage; criterion 3 is not met as written; the read stays outside the request door.
options.label: Lock-free local inbox instead

options.does: Ask plan 261125-1631 to carry the one-line change in its phase 3; phase 4 waits for that land.
options.harm: Phase 4 and everything after it waits on a draft phase of another plan.
options.label: Hand routing to context-engine

parts.recommendation: Widen footprint by routing.rs: it is the smallest change that meets criterion 3 through the existing door, and the overlap with context-engine is a single match arm.

scope.allows: Adding apps/fgos/src/routing.rs to this plan's footprint, used only for the mailbox window arm and its test.
scope.forbids: Any other change to routing.rs or to other plans' footprints.

parts.what: Phase 1 reproduced both confined failures live from this lead head. `mailbox inbox` fails lock-unavailable (EROFS on .fgos/locks/mailbox.lock). A send the host verb rejects comes back as a bare host-failed. Report: plans/261125-2313-head-communication-agent-to-agent/reports/diagnose-confined-mail.md.
